title: Augmentor experience view
description: Interpretive view of one conversational interface that grounds, routes, previews, and presents work while retained owners keep control.

sequences.label: Selective result use and optional intake

allowed_readings: The transcript remains the primary interface.
Source rationale, strategy, Run status, artifacts, and knowledge controls may be progressively disclosed.
Low-confidence or missing-capability routes offer honest paths instead of silently launching.
Memory intake is a separate explicit action after result consumption.
forbidden_authority_moves: The interface cannot make a route, proposal, status card, source chip, or graph authoritative.
A proposal cannot become approval because it is displayed.
A result attachment cannot become memory intake or provider acceptance.
The experience view cannot claim browser accessibility or runtime behavior without executable evidence.
